title: Bevel metrics
description: A centered two-line title and lead over three tall pale blue-grey cards with 32px corners (stacked on phones): each has a 40px name and a grey paragraph at the top and a phone rising out of the bottom edge into a soft peach, blue or green wash.
notes: phones are media slots; empty they are white phone-shaped placeholders
little bottom padding: the original runs the next card straight on
